stories.title: Oratomic raises $300M to build a viable quantum computer that needs only 20K qubits
stories.description: The massive round was co-led by ARCH Venture Partners, Spark Capital, and Khosla Ventures.

stories.title: Netflix could be planning ‘always-on’ live TV channels
stories.description: Amid signs of slowing engagement, Netflix is reportedly considering launching "always-on" live channels, giving subscribers something to tune into 24/7.

stories.title: EU threatens Meta with fines over addictive features on Facebook and Instagram
stories.description: The tech giant is in breach of the Digital Services Act by focusing on features like infinite scroll, autoplay, push notifications, and the highly personalized recommendation algorithms, the European Commission said.

stories.title: Florida ransomware negotiator convicted for helping ransomware gang extort US companies
stories.description: A third ransomware negotiator has been jailed for helping a notorious ransomware group extort American victim companies into paying the hackers.

stories.title: VW Group and unions disagree on plan to streamline the automaker
stories.description: VW's plan calls for half as many models but didn't mention closures or job cuts.

stories.title: Ann Widdecombe murder probe: what we know so far
stories.description: Police say they are searching for a suspect in connection with the former MP's death at her home on Dartmoor.

stories.title: Arthur Fery's Wimbledon run ended by Alexander Zverev in semi-finals
stories.description: Arthur Fery's unforgettable Wimbledon run comes to an end as Alexander Zverev beats the British wildcard to secure a place in the final.

stories.title: Top Boy actor Micheal Ward found not guilty of rape
stories.description: Micheal Ward told the jury the encounter with his accuser was "wholly consensual".

stories.title: A major housing bill is set to become law at midnight — even though Trump says he won't sign
stories.description: President Trump says he is refusing to sign the bill without Congress first passing his sweeping voter ID bill.

stories.title: U.S.-Iran fighting appears to pause. And, life inside Israel's military zones in Gaza
stories.description: Fighting between the U.S. and Iran appears to have paused after two days of clashing amid a shaky ceasefire. And, a look at what life is like inside Israel's expanding zone of control in Gaza.

stories.title: Taliban declares war on smartphones
stories.description: A newly announced ban on smartphones for government workers, police and military personnel is spilling over into healthcare and educational facilities. Ordinary citizens worry they'll be next.

stories.title: Spain vs Belgium LIVE: FIFA World Cup 2026 quarterfinal
stories.description: Live coverage and text updates as Lamine Yamal's Spain face Belgium for the right to meet France in the semifinals.

stories.title: US declassifies even more UFO videos
stories.description: The US government published a fourth instalment of unresolved cases, promising to release more files on a rolling basis.

stories.title: Trump refuses to sign US housing bill over voting act standoff
stories.description: The housing legislation will become US law at midnight with or without President Donald Trump's signature.

stories.title: Family mourns baby after Israeli forces blocked journey to hospital
stories.description: Three-month-old Ahmad Zaid’s family received his birth certificate and death certificate on the same day.

stories.title: The search for Gaza’s missing brings heartbreak and closure for loved ones
stories.description: Thousands of bodies remain trapped under the rubble of their homes in Gaza, with retrieval a long and difficult task.

stories.title: East Asia braces for destructive typhoon as landslides kill 15 in Philippines
stories.description: Heading for Taiwan and south-eastern China, the 1,000 km-wide Bavi is forecast to be one of the strongest storms in decades.

stories.title: My doctor friend objected to his hospital’s fundraising tactics. Did management go too far?
stories.description: “This shocking program was exploiting doctors and the trust inherent in their relationships with patients.”

stories.title: SK Hynix stock opens at $170 on Nasdaq, as trillion-dollar chip company welcomes U.S. investors
stories.description: SK Hynix has soared to a trillion-dollar market cap by serving some of the biggest names in technology, including Nvidia and Apple.

stories.title: All entry-level jobs require 3-5 years of experience. How am I supposed to get that if no one will hire me?
stories.description: How to get experience if no one is willing to be your first employer.

stories.title: Stablecoin issuer Circle just got the greenlight to operate as a bank. The shares are up 5%
stories.description: Stablecoin issuer Circle surged in premarket trading after the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted it approval to operate as a trust bank.

stories.title: Trump says U.S. to continue talks with Iran despite scrapped ceasefire
stories.description: The ceasefire signed last month came under serious strain in recent days as the U.S. and Iranian forces exchanged attacks for consecutive days this week.
